# Marilla Cuthbert

[Conservative](../codex/factions.md#conservative)

## Overview

- **Age:** middle-aged  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P0](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) (child), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman characterized by her sharp angles and lack of curves, eventually becoming shorter than a fifteen-year-old [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Her sallow-cheeked face grows softer over time, while her dark hair, which shows gray streaks that increase with age, is always tightly twisted into a hard little knot in the back secured by two aggressively placed wire hairpins. When attending church, she wears a good brown satin dress paired with a violet-shimmering accessory at her throat.

## Personality

A self-contained and sensible woman, Marilla Cuthbert possesses a rigid conscience and a determined nature, often appearing curt, direct, and critical on the outside. Though she is uninclined to subjective analysis and reserved in expressing her affection, she has mellowed over time and feels proud of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), despite her ongoing efforts to train the girl into a calm, demure disposition. She detests stinginess in children and actively supports the higher education of women, though her own aesthetic sense is not noticeably developed. Subject to headaches that leave her somewhat sarcastic, her crisp demeanor can at times stem from an uncomfortable ignorance rather than malice. Additionally, she is celebrated in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for her skill in crafting three-year-old homemade currant wine.

## History

Growing up as a dark, homely child before the main house at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was built, Marilla Cuthbert carried the pain of an aunt's unkind comment and later regretted a youthful quarrel with John Blythe, whom she refused to forgive. As an adult living with her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), she inherited her mother's amethyst brooch and eventually agreed to adopt a young orphan from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), only to discover a girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived instead of a boy. Though initially inclined to return the imaginative child, Marilla softened upon hearing Anne's harsh childhood history and seeing her distress at the prospect of living with the cruel Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md). Marilla chose to adopt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and immediately took charge of her upbringing and religious education, though Anne's fiery temper and dramatic flair frequently tested her patience. Despite her stern nature, Marilla grew deeply fond of the girl, defending her when a mislabeled bottle of currant wine accidentally intoxicated [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and secretly showing her maternal affection. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) falsely confessed to taking Marilla's missing brooch just so she could attend a picnic, Marilla realized the brooch was actually pinned to her own shawl, prompting her to apologize and send [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the event. Over the years, Marilla supported Anne's ambition to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), weeping as the girl matured and grew into a successful young scholar. Tragedy struck when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly from shock following a bank failure, leaving Marilla devastated and facing her own impending blindness, which threatened her ability to keep [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Experiencing worsening eyesight, Marilla revealed her past romantic history with John Blythe to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who gave up her college scholarship to stay home and care for Marilla and the property.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla becomes Anne's adoptive mother and guardian after an orphan mix-up initially brings the girl to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the expected boy. Though initially shocked and inclined to return [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Marilla grows pitying after hearing the child's painful past and seeing the harsh alternative home awaiting her. She takes on the responsibility of raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), guiding her in household neatness, religious instruction, and proper behavior while balancing her own practical nature against Anne's vivid imagination.

- Parent of — adoptive mother  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- Mentor of — guardian raising her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P3](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0003)</sub>

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Marilla lives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her brother, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), maintaining a shared household where they decide major family matters together. While [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly favors keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from the start, Marilla takes a more practical and critical approach before coming around to his view. Despite their differing temperaments, they work as a unit to raise the girl, with Marilla managing Anne's upbringing and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offering subtle support.

- Sibling of — brother and sister living together at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +13 more</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a outspoken neighbor and friend who frequently visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to share news and advice. Their relationship faces temporary strain when Rachel's harsh insults toward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spark an explosive confrontation, forcing Marilla to balance defending her household with keeping the peace. Marilla respects Rachel's practical wisdom, consulting her for counsel on how to manage Anne's fiery temper and strong-willed decisions.

- Friend of — neighborly acquaintance who seeks her advice  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P40](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0040)</sub>
